Here is a 10-day pescatarian meal plan aligned with a Mediterranean dietary pattern, emphasizing organic and non-processed foods. Each day includes breakfast, lunch, dinner, and two snacks.

Day 1
Breakfast: Organic Greek yogurt with fresh organic berries, chopped walnuts, and a drizzle of raw honey.
Snack 1: One organic apple.
Lunch: Large organic mixed green salad with grilled organic salmon, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and a lemon-olive oil vinaigrette.
Snack 2: A handful of organic almonds.
Dinner: Baked organic cod with roasted organic zucchini, bell peppers, and asparagus seasoned with herbs and olive oil. Side of organic quinoa.

Day 2
Breakfast: Organic oatmeal cooked with water or organic milk, topped with sliced organic banana and chia seeds.
Snack 1: One organic pear.
Lunch: Organic lentil soup with carrots, celery, and onions, served with a slice of organic whole-grain bread.
Snack 2: Organic hummus with organic carrot sticks.
Dinner: Grilled organic shrimp skewers with organic cherry tomatoes and zucchini, served over organic brown rice with a side of steamed organic spinach.

Day 3
Breakfast: Smoothie made with organic spinach, organic banana, organic berries, organic flaxseeds, and organic almond milk.
Snack 1: One organic orange.
Lunch: Organic tuna salad (made with organic olive oil mayo or mashed avocado) served in organic lettuce wraps with sliced avocado.
Snack 2: A small bowl of organic mixed nuts.
Dinner: Organic baked sea bass with organic roasted sweet potatoes and a side of organic sautéed kale with garlic.

Day 4
Breakfast: Two organic poached eggs on a slice of organic whole-grain toast with sliced organic tomato.
Snack 1: One organic peach.
Lunch: Organic chickpea and organic cucumber salad with feta cheese, olives, and a lemon-herb dressing.
Snack 2: Organic cottage cheese with organic pineapple chunks.
Dinner: Organic mackerel fillets baked with organic lemon and dill, served with organic steamed broccoli and organic wild rice.
